subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding lifestyle inflation: the tendency to increase spending as income grows, and why resisting it matters for wealth-building
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two simulated people who both get a raise: one increases spending, one keeps spending flat and increases saving
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a raise scenario to its resulting net worth difference over time
exercise.abstract: Student explains what lifestyle inflation is and why resisting it can dramatically affect long-term wealth

misconception_flags: believes a raise's full value should automatically go toward higher spending rather than being a choice

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
